title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Harding gatherings and practices spanning worship, service, student performance, and campus celebrations.

cards.title: Spring Sing
cards.subtitle: Annual musical revue involving Harding social clubs
cards.notes: Check the official ticket page before planning a visit, then watch the club shows, hosts, ensemble, and jazz band perform together.
cards.short_summary: A large annual student musical revue staged in Benson Auditorium.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes Spring Sing as an annual musical revue involving nearly 1,000 students from more than 20 social clubs.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the next announced performance dates and directs visitors to ticket information.

cards.title: John H. Ryan Sweepstakes Award
cards.subtitle: Spring Sing’s annual top club-show award
cards.notes: Read the current Spring Sing program after the judged performances to see which social-club show receives the Sweepstakes recognition.
cards.short_summary: A recurring award that connects Spring Sing competition to a charity donation.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that Spring Sing club shows are judged and that the John H. Ryan Sweepstakes Award prize money goes to the winning club's chosen charity.
cards.access_notes: This award is announced as part of the annual Spring Sing program; event access follows the current ticket policy.

cards.title: Spring Sing Spirit Award
cards.subtitle: Peer-voted recognition within Spring Sing
cards.notes: Follow the official Spring Sing updates during performance weekend to learn which club show receives the peer-voted Spirit Award.
cards.short_summary: A yearly Spring Sing honor based on club directors’ vote.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding says Spring Sing club directors vote annually for a Spirit Award recognizing the show that demonstrated the spirit of Jesus Christ during rehearsal and performance.
cards.access_notes: The recognition is part of Spring Sing; consult the current event information for attendance details.

cards.title: Harding University Chapel
cards.subtitle: Weekday worship gathering in Benson Auditorium
cards.notes: Confirm the current chapel schedule and attendance expectations, then arrive on time for a respectful weekday worship gathering.
cards.short_summary: A campus worship practice Harding traces to its first semester in 1924.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding's University Historical Collections calls chapel an important tradition dating to the university's first semester and describes weekday chapel services in Benson Auditorium.
cards.source_title: Harding University Chapel | University Historical Collections
cards.access_notes: Chapel times and access expectations can vary; verify current arrangements through Harding before attending.

cards.title: Inspire Bible Lectureship
cards.subtitle: Long-running Harding Bible lecture gathering
cards.notes: Review the College of Bible and Ministry event listing when dates are posted, then select sessions that match your interests.
cards.short_summary: A university gathering Harding says has been part of its life since its first fall as a four-year college.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Bible Lectureship tradition began in its first fall as a four-year college and brings together students and friends of the university.
cards.source_title: Bible and Ministry Events | Harding University
cards.access_notes: Program dates, registration, and session access are set for each year; use the official event listing before making plans.

cards.title: Stampede
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation and welcome weekend
cards.notes: Incoming students should follow the official move-in and session schedule, using the weekend to learn campus routines and meet peers.
cards.short_summary: Harding’s required orientation experience for incoming first-year and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding identifies Stampede as its new-student orientation and welcome weekend and says it is required for incoming freshmen and transfer students.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 2026 dates, registration timing, and eligibility; it is a student-only experience.

cards.title: Bisons for Christ
cards.subtitle: Annual community service day
cards.notes: Use the VOMO sign-up process or contact Community Connection to join a project, request transportation, or submit a project idea.
cards.short_summary: A yearly service day connecting Harding participants with local projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes Bisons for Christ as an annual day of service in which students connect with and serve their communities through projects.
cards.access_notes: Project lists and sign-up details are provided through VOMO or the Office of Community Connection.

cards.title: Harding Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni, student, and campus celebration
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to choose a daytime activity, such as chapel or the Harding History Tour, before arranging travel.
cards.short_summary: A fall gathering that combines alumni return, campus activities, and Bison events.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding's official Homecoming page lists its 2026 celebration and a self-guided Harding History Tour among the scheduled activities.
cards.access_notes: Specific events, including athletic contests and performances, may have separate access or ticket requirements.

cards.title: Harding Lights
cards.subtitle: Annual campus holiday light display
cards.notes: Visit during the announced seasonal display period and take a walk around the Front Lawn while respecting campus operations and weather.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal light display that links Harding’s Front Lawn with Searcy’s holiday programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes #HardingLights as an annual university light display, beginning with a lighting ceremony and continuing through New Year's.
cards.access_notes: The official page says the display begins with a lighting ceremony and continues through New Year's; confirm the upcoming season's dates.

cards.title: Harding Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual campus weekend for students and families
cards.notes: Register through the official Family Weekend page when registration opens, then build a visit around the published campus schedule.
cards.short_summary: A recurring opportunity for Harding students to welcome family members to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding's student-written university news describes Family Weekend as an annual tradition for families to join students, faculty, and staff in celebrating the Harding community.
cards.source_title: Welcome Home for Family Weekend | Harding University News
cards.access_notes: Harding lists Family Weekend dates and asks families to register; individual scheduled activities can have separate requirements.
